talentiPopis.opis: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock spells by 5%.
Your Critical Strikes with direct damage spells increase your chance to get a Critical Strike with melee attacks by 9% for 10 sec.
Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and by your Flame Shock and Fire Nova spells by 10%, as well as increases the duration of your Flame Shock spell by 6 sec.
Gives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell.  The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.
Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 5%.
Increases your Intellect by 10%.
Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 100% of your Intellect.
Reduces the mana cost of your Shock and Lightning Shield spells by 45%.

Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 3.0 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.

Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.
When you Stormstrike, you have a 100% chance to gain 50% mana regeneration while casting spells for 15 sec, and Stormstrike's cooldown has a 100% chance to reset each time you Dodge or Parry.

When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a 38% chance (based on weapon speed) to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.
Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 5% and improves your chance to hit by 5%.
Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
Reduces the Mana cost of your totems and any spells that summon or move them by 10%.

The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds.  Lasts 10 min.

Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

Increases your Parry chance by 5%.
Reduces the Mana cost of all instant cast spells and abilities by 2%.
Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement ability by 2 sec.

Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.  Lasts 30 sec.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 87 to 91 Holy damage, 173 to 183 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.
Increases movement speed and mounted movement speed by 15%.  This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.
Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 20% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.
Increases the Physical and Holy damage you deal by 6%, and reduces all threat you generate by 20% while a two-handed melee weapon is equipped.
Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.
Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 3% for 30 sec after landing a non-periodic critical strike.  Stacks up to 5 times.
Increases your spell damage by up to 60% of your Intellect, and reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 1.0 sec.

Your melee attacks store a copy of your active Seal for 15 sec, stacking up to 3 times. Landing an attack with a different Seal consumes all stacks, giving the stored Seal its normal chance to activate once per stack.
